company.name: Baubap
company.shortDescription: Baubap is a developer of a microlending financial platform that offers personal loans.
company.description:
Baubap is a developer of a microlending financial platform designed to offer personal loans. The company's platform offers instant loans to customers through its mobile application without the need for documents or convoluted processes, thereby enabling users to apply for a loan anytime and anywhere.

Baubap was founded in 2018 by Luis Villarreal, Roberto Salcedo and Conrad Wilkinson Schwarz and is based in Mexico.

productsAndServices.description: Offers personal loans ranging from $500 to $9,000 MXN with repayment terms from 90 days up to 24 months.
productsAndServices.name: Personal Loans

productsAndServices.description: A program that allows clients to access future credit more quickly by paying loans on time or early.
productsAndServices.name: Garantía Baubap (Baubap Guarantee)

productsAndServices.description: A referral program where users earn monetary rewards for inviting others who complete loan applications and receive approved loans.
productsAndServices.name: Invita y Gana (Invite and Earn) Referral Program

productsAndServices.description: A rewards program that returns a percentage of interest to clients who pay their loans on time consecutively, starting from the third loan.
productsAndServices.name: Va de Vuelta (Return Program)

productsAndServices.description: Allows clients to pay their loans in cash at over 30,000 affiliated stores across Mexico using a payment reference code.
productsAndServices.name: Loan Payment Network
